The documents don't cover Valencia Street Circuit. None of the eight races listed (Barcelona, Bahrain, Silverstone, Abu Dhabi, Canada, Zandvoort, and the 2000 and 2006 Spanish GPs) took place there, so the retrieved information can't answer this.

From memory rather than the documents, Fernando Alonso is the most likely answer, having won the European Grand Prix at Valencia in 2010 and 2012. I'm not certain of the full list of Valencia winners, so please verify this against a race results source.

ANSWER: Fernando Alonso
